evals.name: Domain Error Hierarchy & HTTP Status Mapping
evals.prompt: Implement a domain service that throws explicit typed errors (NotFoundError, ConflictError) and verify they map cleanly to 404 and 409 status codes.
evals.expected_output: Defines typed errors extending BaseAppError and asserts that the global error handler resolves them with correct HTTP status codes.
assertions: Defines BaseAppError base class with code, httpStatus, and isOperational fields
Ensures domain services throw typed subclasses instead of raw generic Error
Maps NotFoundError to 404 and ConflictError to 409 in the global filter

evals.name: Operational vs Programmer Error Triage & Alerting Hook
evals.prompt: Implement a global error handler that logs operational 4xx errors as WARN without alerting, but logs unexpected 500 errors as ERROR with an on-call alert dispatch.
evals.expected_output: Differentiates errors by isOperational flag, routes 4xx to WARN logs, and routes 500s to ERROR logs with on-call alert invocation.
assertions: Classifies errors into Operational (isOperational: true) and Programmer (isOperational: false)
Logs operational business errors at WARN severity with correlationId
Logs unexpected programmer errors at ERROR severity with complete stack trace
Dispatches an automated on-call incident alert hook on 500 errors

evals.name: Detection & Remediation of Swallowed Exceptions
evals.prompt: Audit a codebase containing empty catch blocks 'catch (e) {}' and refactor them to log the exception context or properly rethrow.
evals.expected_output: Identifies empty catch blocks and replaces them with structured warning logs or rethrows a typed DomainError.
assertions: Detects empty catch blocks that silently swallow exceptions
Prohibits silent exception suppression without logging or rethrowing
Enforces logging of error context if an exception is intentionally non-fatal
Preserves complete error stack traces for upstream debugging
